caption: of Ladakh's renewable power planned for the grid via a 480 km line to Haryana.
captionHeadline: 13 GW of clean power from Ladakh is headed for the national grid.
summary: The Ladakh–Haryana Green Energy Corridor will integrate 13 GW of renewable energy through a 5 GW transmission system, including a 480 km HVDC line from Pang (Ladakh) to Kaithal (Haryana). The project was recommended under PM GatiShakti.

headline: Dhubri to Phulbari, before and after the bridge
captionHeadline: 205 km becomes 20 km: the planned Dhubri–Phulbari bridge.
summary: A four-lane bridge between Dhubri (Assam) and Phulbari (Meghalaya) is planned to cut the trip from 205 km to 20 km, and travel time from about 7 hours to 30 minutes. These are the government's projections.

caption: less forest land on the 699 km Pune–Bengaluru Expressway's revised route.
captionHeadline: The Pune–Bengaluru Expressway route was redrawn to cut forest land overlap by 19%.
summary: Planners used the PM GatiShakti map to revise the 699 km expressway's alignment, reducing its overlap with forest land by 19%.

caption: big infra projects, worth about ₹18.66 lakh crore, screened by PM GatiShakti's planners.
note: 256 sanctioned, 198 under way, as of 11 Aug 2026.
captionHeadline: PM GatiShakti turns 5: 396 big projects screened so far.
summary: As of 11 August 2026, the Network Planning Group had evaluated 396 projects worth about ₹18.66 lakh crore. 256 were sanctioned and 198 are under implementation.

caption: central ministries and departments now plan on one shared PM GatiShakti map.
note: Plus all 36 States and Union Territories.
captionHeadline: 58 ministries, 36 States and UTs, one map.
summary: Five years after launch, PM GatiShakti covers 58 central ministries and departments and all 36 States and UTs, with over 23,493 data layers as of 12 October 2026.

caption: approved public datasets you can open on the PM GatiShakti public platform.
captionHeadline: 230 government infrastructure datasets are now public.
summary: The PM GatiShakti public platform offers 230 approved datasets, useful for startups, researchers and planners.

caption: foreign air forces flew with the IAF at Tarang Shakti 2026 in Jodhpur.
captionHeadline: Tarang Shakti 2026 wraps up in Jodhpur.
summary: The IAF-hosted exercise ran from 26 September to 12 October. Air forces of Australia, Bangladesh, France, Germany, Sri Lanka, the UAE and the US took part, with 32 observer nations. India showcased the LCA Tejas and LCH Prachand.

headline: Soil drive begins
note: Field teams will advise farmers on soil tests, stubble and fertiliser use.
source: Agriculture Ministry review, via The News Mill
captionHeadline: Khet Bachao Abhiyan, a nationwide soil-health drive, starts 22 October.
summary: Agricultural scientists and field staff will visit farms to advise on soil testing, conserving organic matter, avoiding stubble burning and balanced fertiliser use. Announced at the Agriculture Ministry's review chaired by Shivraj Singh Chouhan.

caption: of the 14 crore Farmer ID target done: 10.77 crore IDs created so far.
source: Agriculture Ministry review, via The News Mill
captionHeadline: 10.77 crore Farmer IDs created, about 77% of the 14 crore target.
summary: Figures shared at the Agriculture Ministry's monthly review under the Digital Agriculture Mission. The 77% is our calculation: 10.77 crore ÷ 14 crore.
